deviations_from_adr: ADR §5/§7 recommended a per-task founder frozen-sanction for the Check-6 false-red on agents.ts/grants.ts. The FOUNDER instead chose the root-cause fix: NARROW Check-6 so it no longer over-reaches onto src/http route handlers. Implemented as such. This is a sanctioned change of approach, not a silent contract drift — the security decision (mode-aware withAuth wrap + authHeaders() migration) is unchanged from the ADR.

Resolved with 3 append-only FOUNDER-class sanction lines in frozen-sanctions.jsonl (FF-FCI12), decision field citing the real control-plane signal founder_request:T-0291-keycloak-gate (NOT a fabricated founder_decide). Reviewer must scrutinize this authorization trail (see notes).
